Masonry walls are the main load
bearing elements and are expected
to resist both gravity and lateral
loads. Confining elements (tie-
beams
and
tie-columns)
are
significantly smaller in size than
RC beams and columns.
RC frames resist both gravity
and lateral loads through
their relatively large beams,
columns,
and
their
connections. Masonry in fills
are not load-bearing walls.
